prompts.L1:
Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

A sheet-like article (1) for an absorbent article of the invention includes a plurality of absorbent units (4), each including a long base portion (2) and water-absorbent polymer particles (3) fixed to a surface of one face of the long base portion (2). In the sheet-like article (1), the absorbent units (4) are arranged such that their longitudinal direction is oriented in one direction. Before the water-absorbent polymer particles (3) absorb a liquid, the water-absorbent polymer particles (3) are located inward of both lateral side edge portions (2s), of the long base portion (2), that extend along the longitudinal direction. When the water-absorbent polymer particles (3) absorb a liquid, the water-absorbent polymer particles (3) swell beyond the lateral side edge portions (2s), of the long base portion (2), that extend along the longitudinal direction, and a position, in the thickness direction, of the long base portion (2) is varied from the position thereof before absorbing the liquid.

outputs.L1: A sheet-like article (1) for an absorbent article according to the invention includes a plurality of absorbent units (4), each comprising an elongated base portion (2) and water-absorbent polymer particles (3) fixed to one surface of the elongated base portion (2). In the sheet-like article (1), the absorbent units (4) are arranged with their longitudinal directions aligned in a single direction. Before absorbing liquid, the water-absorbent polymer particles (3) are positioned inward of both lateral side edge portions (2s) of the elongated base portion (2), which extend in the longitudinal direction. Upon absorbing liquid, the water-absorbent polymer particles (3) swell beyond these lateral side edge portions (2s), thereby changing the position of the elongated base portion (2) in the thickness direction relative to its position before liquid absorption.
outputs.L2: The invention provides a sheet-form component (1) for use in an absorbent article. The component contains multiple absorbent units (4), each formed from an elongated base section (2) and water-absorbing polymer particles (3) secured to one surface of the base section (2). The absorbent units (4) are aligned so that their lengthwise axes extend in the same direction. Prior to liquid absorption, the polymer particles (3) remain inside the two longitudinally extending side edges (2s) of the elongated base section (2). Upon taking up liquid, the particles (3) expand past those side edges (2s), causing the elongated base section (2) to shift in the thickness direction relative to its pre-absorption position.
outputs.L3: The sheet-like absorbent article comprises a plurality of absorbent units arranged such that their longitudinal directions are aligned. Each absorbent unit includes an elongated base portion having water-absorbent polymer particles fixed to one of its surfaces. Before liquid absorption, the polymer particles are positioned inward of both lateral side edges of the base portion. When the particles absorb liquid, they swell and expand beyond the lateral side edges, causing the position of the base portion to shift in the thickness direction of the absorbent article.
outputs.L4:
The sheet-like absorbent article includes a plurality of elongated base units arranged in substantially the same direction. Each base unit has a first surface on which water-absorbent polymer particles are fixed. Before use, the particles are disposed within the lateral edges of the corresponding base unit when viewed in the thickness direction. This arrangement helps maintain a thin, stable structure and limits unintended movement or loss of the particles while the article is dry.

When liquid reaches the article, the polymer particles absorb the liquid and increase in volume. As they swell, at least some of the particles expand laterally beyond one or both edges of the base unit on which they are supported. The resulting expansion applies force to adjacent portions of the structure, causing the base units, or portions thereof, to move relative to one another in the thickness direction.

This controlled displacement increases the thickness and internal volume of the absorbent article where liquid is present. It can also create or enlarge spaces between neighboring base units, thereby providing additional room for the swollen polymer and facilitating further liquid intake and distribution. Because the deformation is generated by the swelling particles themselves, the article can remain comparatively thin before use while developing a larger absorption volume after wetting.

By aligning the elongated base units and confining the particles within their lateral edges in the initial state, the expansion can occur in a predictable manner. The structure therefore reduces excessive particle migration, maintains the integrity of the absorbent layer, and converts polymer swelling into useful three-dimensional expansion, resulting in improved absorption capacity, liquid retention, and fit during use.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a patent-style abstract describing a sheet-like absorbent article made of aligned elongated base portions with water-absorbent polymer particles that expand laterally and shift the base portions in the thickness direction upon absorbing liquid.
counterfactuals.output: A sheet-like absorbent article comprises a plurality of elongated base portions arranged in substantial alignment and water-absorbent polymer particles disposed on or between the elongated base portions. Upon contact with a liquid, the water-absorbent polymer particles absorb the liquid and expand in a direction intersecting the longitudinal direction of the elongated base portions. The resulting expansion applies a lateral force to adjacent elongated base portions, causing at least some of the elongated base portions to shift relative to one another in a thickness direction of the article. This displacement increases the effective thickness and internal void volume of the article, thereby facilitating liquid uptake, distribution, and retention while reducing interference between swollen polymer particles. The aligned configuration provides a thin, flexible structure before use and enables controlled three-dimensional deformation during absorption.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Summarize the key structure and swelling behavior of the absorbent article shown in the patent figures, preserving reference numerals (1), (2), (2s), (3), and (4).
counterfactuals.output: The absorbent article (1) includes an absorbent body (2) covered or restrained by a sheet/member (3) having an opening (4). When the absorbent body (2) takes up liquid, its swelling portion (2s) expands preferentially and rises or protrudes through the opening (4). Thus, swelling is directed outward at a defined location rather than occurring uniformly, creating a localized raised region while the surrounding structure remains comparatively constrained.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a technical patent paragraph for an absorbent sheet comprising multiple longitudinally oriented absorbent units, each having polymer particles fixed to one surface of a long base.
counterfactuals.output: An absorbent sheet comprises a plurality of elongated absorbent units arranged such that longitudinal axes of the absorbent units extend substantially parallel to one another, each absorbent unit including an elongated base having a first surface and a plurality of water-absorbent polymer particles fixed to the first surface. The absorbent units may be disposed side by side, with the polymer-particle-bearing first surfaces oriented in a common thickness direction, thereby forming a longitudinally continuous absorbent structure configured to receive, distribute, and retain liquid.
counterfactuals.label: cf_3

counterfactuals.prompt: Explain, in formal patent language, how water-absorbent polymer particles are positioned relative to the lateral edges of an elongated base before liquid absorption and how their swelling changes the article afterward.
counterfactuals.output: Prior to liquid absorption, water-absorbent polymer particles are disposed on at least one surface of an elongated base such that the particles are located laterally inward of the opposed longitudinal side edges of the base, thereby defining particle-free marginal regions adjacent the respective side edges. Upon contact with liquid, the particles absorb the liquid and swell. The resulting increase in particle volume causes the absorbent region to expand, particularly in the thickness and lateral directions, such that the swollen polymer approaches, reaches, or extends beyond the lateral edges of the base and thereby increases the effective cross-sectional dimensions and alters the configuration of the article relative to its dry-state configuration.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate an English patent abstract for an invention in which superabsorbent particles initially lie within both longitudinal side edges of aligned strip-shaped supports, then swell past those edges and displace the supports through the sheet thickness.
counterfactuals.output: An absorbent sheet includes a plurality of strip-shaped supports arranged in alignment and superabsorbent particles supported thereon. In an unswollen state, the superabsorbent particles are located inward of both longitudinal side edges of each strip-shaped support. Upon contact with liquid, the superabsorbent particles absorb the liquid and swell laterally beyond the longitudinal side edges. Continued swelling displaces at least portions of the strip-shaped supports in a sheet-thickness direction, thereby increasing the thickness and liquid-retaining volume of the absorbent sheet. The resulting three-dimensional structure provides expansion space for the particles, reduces restriction of particle swelling, and maintains liquid uptake and retention while limiting particle migration.
counterfactuals.label: cf_5
